Name: Cylinder head assembly
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Regent Executive; Foreman Crew Cab
Description: A complete four valve head with camshafts, valves and springs fitted, supplied with the gasket set. Machined and pressure tested as an assembly, so the line fits it without further preparation.

Name: Turbocharger assembly
Fits: Concord Hybrid Saloon; Meridian GT; Trailhead Wagon
Description: A single scroll turbocharger with an integrated wastegate actuator, balanced to 180,000 rpm. The oil and coolant feed ports match the standard head casting, so no adapter is required.

Name: Timing chain kit
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Meridian GT; Cityhop Compact
Description: Chain, both guides, the tensioner and the sprockets in one box, because replacing the chain alone puts a new part against worn guides. The kit covers every engine in the four cylinder family.

Name: Oil pump module
Fits: Longhaul Estate; Auralis Grand Tourer; Apex Hypercar
Description: A variable displacement pump with the pickup and strainer attached. Output is regulated against oil temperature rather than engine speed alone, which is what keeps consumption down at motorway cruise.

Name: Fuel rail with injectors
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Velocia Coupe; Apex Hypercar
Description: A direct injection rail delivered with four matched injectors already fitted and flow tested as a set. Matching the injectors at the factory is what keeps cylinder to cylinder variation inside tolerance.

Name: High pressure fuel pump
Fits: Concord Hybrid Saloon; Nimbus Crossover
Description: A camshaft driven pump rated to 250 bar with the pressure sensor in the body. Rebuild is not offered: the internal clearances are set on assembly and cannot be restored in the field.

Name: Radiator core
Fits: Longhaul Estate; Foreman Crew Cab; Trailhead Wagon
Description: A double row core sized for towing rather than for the empty vehicle. The tanks are moulded with the transmission cooler ports in place, so one part covers both the manual and the automatic build.

Name: Intercooler
Fits: Meridian GT; Nimbus Crossover; Concord Hybrid Saloon
Description: A bar and plate charge air cooler with cast end tanks. The pressure drop across it is under 0.1 bar at full load, which is the figure the engine calibration assumes.

Name: Water pump
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Cityhop Compact; Trailcut 200
Fits Yachts: Fathom 72; Cirrus 88; Windward 130; Sable 240; Sirocco 68; Avelon 295
Description: A belt driven pump with a sealed bearing and a composite impeller, supplied with the housing gasket. The impeller is moulded rather than pressed on, which removes the usual failure point.

Name: Exhaust manifold
Fits: Longhaul Estate; Auralis Grand Tourer
Description: A four into one cast manifold with the oxygen sensor boss already machined. Cast iron is chosen over fabricated steel for thermal cycling life, at the cost of weight.

Name: Catalytic converter
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Regent Executive; Concord Hybrid Saloon
Description: A close coupled converter with the flexible joint welded to the inlet. The substrate reaches light off within ninety seconds of a cold start, which is what the emissions figure depends on.

Name: Six speed manual gearbox
Fits: Meridian GT; Trailcut 200; Foreman Crew Cab
Description: A complete transverse gearbox with the differential inside the case, filled and run in on the test bench before dispatch. The ratios are the close set used in the sporting build.

Name: Clutch and dual mass flywheel kit
Fits: Meridian GT; Cityhop Compact; Foreman Crew Cab
Description: The flywheel, clutch disc, cover and release bearing as one part number, because the flywheel is not worth reusing at this mileage. The lining is organic rather than ceramic for road use.

Name: Torque converter
Fits: Longhaul Estate; Regent Executive; Nimbus Crossover
Description: A lock up converter matched to the seven and eight speed automatics. The stall speed is set for towing, so the unit is not interchangeable with the sporting calibration.

Name: Rear differential unit
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Velocia Coupe; Apex Hypercar
Description: A limited slip differential supplied as a filled assembly with the crown wheel and pinion already lapped as a pair. The pair is matched at the factory and must not be split.

Name: Constant velocity joint
Fits: Cityhop Compact; Trailhead Wagon; Dune Runner
Description: An outer joint supplied with the boot, clip and the correct quantity of grease. The boot is the part that fails first, which is why it is never sold separately from the joint.

Name: Front brake caliper
Fits: Velocia Coupe; Apex Hypercar; Circuit One Racer
Description: A six piston fixed caliper for the 380 mm disc, supplied without pads. The body is a single casting rather than two halves bolted together, so it holds its shape under sustained braking.

Name: Ventilated brake disc
Fits: Velocia Coupe; Auralis Grand Tourer; Circuit One Racer
Description: A 380 mm internally vented disc with curved vanes, sold singly rather than in pairs. The vane direction makes it side specific, which the part number suffix records.

Name: Brake master cylinder
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Cityhop Compact; Trailhead Wagon
Description: A tandem cylinder with the reservoir and level sensor fitted. Bore size differs between the towing and the standard build, so the two are not interchangeable.

Name: Front strut assembly
Fits: Trailhead Wagon; Nimbus Crossover; Cityhop Compact
Description: A complete corner: damper, spring, upper mount and bearing assembled and aligned. Fitting it as a unit removes the spring compressor from the workshop procedure entirely.

Name: Coil spring
Fits: Cityhop Compact; Trailcut 200; Dune Runner
Description: A progressive rate spring, powder coated after shot peening. Springs are supplied in matched pairs by axle because a single replacement pulls the ride height out of level.

Name: Anti roll bar
Fits: Longhaul Estate; Foreman Crew Cab; Trailhead Wagon
Description: A hollow bar with the drop links and bushes included. Hollow section saves two kilograms over the solid bar at the same roll stiffness.

Name: Steering rack
Fits: Regent Executive; Nimbus Crossover; Auralis Grand Tourer
Description: An electrically assisted rack with the motor and control unit mounted on the housing. The unit is coded to the vehicle on fitting, so a used replacement will not work without it.

Name: Alternator
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Longhaul Estate; Foreman Crew Cab
Description: A 180 ampere water cooled alternator with an overrunning pulley. The pulley is what keeps the belt quiet through the gear changes and is included in the price.

Name: Starter motor
Fits: Meridian GT; Trailcut 200; Dune Runner
Description: A gear reduction starter with the solenoid mounted on the drive end. Reduction gearing lets a smaller motor turn a cold engine, which is the whole reason the unit is this size.

Name: Engine control unit
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Concord Hybrid Saloon; Nimbus Crossover
Description: The engine controller in a sealed cast case with two sockets on the end face. It is delivered blank and coded to the vehicle on fitting, so the part cannot be swapped between cars as it stands.

Name: Ignition coil pack
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Cityhop Compact; Velocia Coupe
Description: Four pencil coils on a common carrier, moulded rather than potted. The carrier keeps the plug boots aligned with the wells, which is what makes fitting it a two minute job.

Name: Lithium starter battery
Material: Lithium iron phosphate cells, polymer case
Fits: Apex Hypercar; Circuit One Racer; Velocia Coupe
Description: A drop in replacement for the lead acid battery at a third of the weight, with the management electronics inside the case. Cold cranking performance is unchanged down to minus twenty.

Name: Air conditioning compressor
Fits: Regent Executive; Longhaul Estate; Nimbus Crossover
Description: A variable displacement compressor with an electromagnetic clutch pulley. Displacement follows cabin demand instead of cycling the clutch, which is both quieter and easier on the belt.

Name: Heater core
Fits: Cityhop Compact; Trailcut 200; Foreman Crew Cab
Description: A small aluminium heat exchanger with two spigots on one face. Replacing it means opening the dashboard, which is why the part is cheap and the job is not.

Name: Cabin blower motor
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Trailhead Wagon; Regent Executive
Description: A squirrel cage blower with the speed resistor pack fitted to the housing. The resistor is the part that usually fails, and it is included rather than sold separately.

Name: Front bumper carrier
Fits: Longhaul Estate; Trailhead Wagon; Foreman Crew Cab
Description: The structural beam behind the bumper cover, with two crush cans bolted to its ends. The cans are designed to fold at a known load, so the beam and the rails behind it survive a low speed impact.

Name: Door mirror assembly
Fits: Regent Executive; Nimbus Crossover; Concord Hybrid Saloon
Description: A powered folding mirror with heating and the indicator repeater in the housing. The glass is supplied fitted and pre aimed, so no adjustment is needed on the line.

Name: Headlamp unit
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Auralis Grand Tourer; Velocia Coupe
Description: A full LED headlamp with the driver module mounted on the housing. Beam pattern is set at the factory and only the vertical aim is adjustable once fitted.

Name: Tail lamp unit
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Longhaul Estate; Cityhop Compact
Description: A sealed LED tail lamp with the connector moulded into the back of the housing. There are no serviceable bulbs inside, which is why the warranty runs to three years.

Name: Instrument cluster
Fits: Concord Hybrid Saloon; Nimbus Crossover; Regent Executive
Description: A twelve inch display cluster with the graphics stack on board. Mileage is written to the cluster on coding, so a replacement leaves the recorded distance intact.

Name: Steering wheel
Fits: Velocia Coupe; Apex Hypercar; Auralis Grand Tourer
Description: A flat bottomed wheel on a cast magnesium frame with the control switches wired in. The airbag module is not included and is ordered against its own part number.

Name: Front seat frame
Fits: Longhaul Estate; Foreman Crew Cab; Trailhead Wagon
Description: The bare frame with runners, recliner mechanism and the height adjuster fitted, supplied without foam or trim. Seat covers follow the trim level and are ordered separately.

Name: Alloy road wheel
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Meridian GT; Nimbus Crossover
Description: A nineteen inch flow formed wheel, machined on the face and painted on the spokes. Flow forming gives the rim barrel the strength of a forging at close to casting cost.

Name: Wheel hub bearing unit
Fits: Cityhop Compact; Trailcut 200; Dune Runner
Description: A sealed double row bearing with the flange and the speed sensor ring as one unit. Nothing inside is serviceable: the assembly is replaced complete.

Name: Front subframe
Fits: Nimbus Crossover; Trailhead Wagon; Regent Executive
Description: The cradle that carries the lower arms, the steering rack and the engine mounts. It is hydroformed in one piece, so a bent subframe is replaced rather than straightened.

Name: Engine mount
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Concord Hybrid Saloon; Cityhop Compact
Description: A hydraulically damped mount: fluid inside the bush takes out the idle shake that a plain rubber mount passes into the floor. Fitted orientation is marked on the bracket.

Name: Fuel tank
Fits: Longhaul Estate; Trailhead Wagon; Foreman Crew Cab
Description: A blow moulded tank with the pump flange, level sender and internal baffles in place. The multi layer wall is what keeps hydrocarbon permeation inside the legal limit.

Name: Evaporative canister
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Meridian GT; Velocia Coupe
Description: The charcoal canister that holds tank vapour until the engine draws it in. It is a sealed part with three hose spigots and no service interval.

Name: Intake manifold
Fits: Meridian GT; Cityhop Compact; Trailcut 200
Description: A composite manifold with variable length runners and the throttle body flange machined into the casting. Composite is chosen for the smoother bore surface, not only for the weight.

Name: Air filter housing
Fits: Trailcut 200; Dune Runner; Foreman Crew Cab
Description: A two piece airbox with the intake snorkel and the mass airflow sensor boss moulded in, supplied with a filter element fitted. The clips are the serviceable part and come in the box.

Name: Transfer case
Fits: Trailcut 200; Foreman Crew Cab; Trailhead Wagon
Description: A two speed transfer case with an electric range shift actuator on the housing. Low range is a mechanical reduction rather than a calibration, which is why it weighs what it does.

Name: Front brake pad set
Fits: Kestrel Sport Sedan; Longhaul Estate; Cityhop Compact
Description: Four pads with the wear sensor and the shims in the box. The compound is the road version, which is quiet cold at the cost of the fade resistance a track pad would give.
